verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a financial-crime risk platform, so chargeback dispute automation is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence covers only sanctions/PEP screening, case management, transaction monitoring and data exports. Nothing shows compiling order, delivery or session evidence, or submitting dispute responses to issuers. Transaction CSV exports and case audit trails are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, chargeback responses are automated — evidence compiled from order, delivery, and session data and submitted to the issuer without manual copy-paste
